avis.titre: Amazing Serum for Calm, Hydrated Skin – Perfect for Sensitive Types!
avis.texte: The Anua Heartleaf 80 Soothing Ampoule has become my go-to skincare staple! My skin tends to be sensitive and reactive, but this serum has a calming effect that’s noticeable from the first application. The heartleaf extract and B5 (panthenol) work beautifully together to reduce redness and soothe any irritation, leaving my skin feeling comfortable and balanced. The texture is lightweight and non-greasy, so it absorbs quickly without any residue—perfect for layering under other products or makeup. After a few weeks, my skin looks visibly healthier and more hydrated, with a smoother, more even tone. This ampoule has been especially effective on days when my skin needs extra hydration without the heaviness of thick creams. If you have sensitive or combination skin and want a product that hydrates deeply while calming the skin, I highly recommend the Anua Heartleaf 80 Ampoule. It’s gentle, effective, and feels like a mini spa treatment every time!

This has definitely added more hydration to my skin. I have very dry skin and am super sensitive when it comes to skincare so I was very unsure of it causing any breakouts. I have not had any breakouts at all which is amazing! Doesn’t have any scent to it I appreciate that. It’s really just hydrated my skin that’s it which is what I bought it for it adds an extra glow effect and I feel like my skin has gotten better for sure!

Love this serum down, it makes my skin feel sooooooooo good, plump and dewy, it's a bit sticky after application but not greasy. It doesn't have any kinda scent really so it's great for sensitive skin which I have. It really gives a sort of glass skin effect after use. I'm almost out I plan to get another one soon!
Great for redness. I always wake up with my rosacea calm and ready to take on the day.

avis.titre: Hydrating and Gentle, But Runs Out QuicklyHydrating and Gentle, But Runs Out Quickly
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Heartleaf 80 Soothing Ampoule as part of my daily skincare routine, and overall I’ve really enjoyed it. The formula feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well with the rest of my products without feeling sticky or greasy. What I liked: • Lightweight, comfortable texture • Hydrating without feeling heavy • Layers nicely with toner, moisturizer, and sunscreen • Feels soothing and gentle on the skin • Works well for daily use Things to note: • The bottle seems to run out fairly quickly compared to some other serums I’ve used • I wish the dropper was just a little longer to make it easier to reach the product as the bottle gets low Overall, this is a nice hydrating ampoule that feels comfortable on the skin and fits easily into a skincare routine. The formula itself is great, but I deducted one star because I would have liked a bit more product and a slightly longer dropper for easier use. Update: add photo

I really love this ampoule! It feels lightweight, absorbs beautifully into my skin, and leaves my face feeling hydrated and calm. It has become a great addition to my skincare routine, especially when my skin needs extra care.
I will definitely repurchase, it gives long lasting hydration
Adoro questo brand! ottimo per la mia pelle delicata. Il siero è la svolta

Probably one of the best hydrating face lotions I've used, and I've tried at least 20-30 different types and brands. It absorbs so well into my skin and doesn't leave it feeling greasy at all. I have combination skin, and my nose, chin, and forehead usually break out. I use it every night and morning after my serums, and it works wonders on my skin.

This is my 3rd bottle of Anua Heartleaf 80 Moisture Soothing Ampoule. 1st was a very nice smooth consistency with medium thickness and worked great! 2nd order was thinned/watered down so I returned it and received an exchange which was also thin. I was disappointed but kept it. This 3rd bottle is now back to the amazing quality as the 1st! Thank you Anua for not skimping on the product and returning to the great quality product you started with. Provides amazing moisture to skin, non-greasy, non-sticky after dries. I love that it is unscented!!!

This was so calming on my face. My face is sensitive to the touch and turns red even just doing my skincare. But this made my skin so cool. Like I loved it😭 I’m so sad I ran out. but now, I know I can for sure say that this did wonders for my skin. And my skin is really dry so on top of being calming it was moisturizing.

avis.titre: If I could give this serum 10 stars I would.
avis.texte: This serum is the best serum I’ve EVER used on my face. I’m not even exaggerating. It makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. Especially because I have REALLY dry skin. And I’ve tried a lot of different serums and moisturizers but this one is by far the best .

This Korean serum has limited English instructions on the box which is to be expected and a non-issue for me. This serum states it is contains natural ingredients including 80% heart leaf extract water from Korea. I was initially shocked when I first tried this serum for my video review. I placed the serum on my hand and rubbed it in slightly and it absorbed is tangly without an greasy residue left behind. I put the serum onto my face before bed and woke up with supple hydrated skin. I really like this serum and will continue using it. I no longer wear foundation but this serum would be a great base layer for those who use foundation. I wanted to come back with an update after using this serum for months. I used nothing but this serum on my face the other morning before going to work and someone said "You get facials don't you, you're glowing". I see comments that the serum is a little sticky but it works best to use it on a freshly washed face and pat it in your skin instead of rubbing it in. I am interested in trying the entire line of products after trying this serum. This serum really does give you the "Glass Skin" look. I'm very impressed

avis.titre: The product doesn't come with the box
avis.texte: It's really weird to see the product without packaging box, and it makes me wonder if the product has been used before or not, but I'm not happy with how it appears to me, and I don't know if I will use it.

Admittedly, I was hesitant to try this. I have never used an ampoule and I'm not sure what heartleaf is. I have sort of sensitive skin with rosacea, so I have to be careful with what I use. I use serums regularly and know they can be hit or miss. I was worried this would be sticky or too thick, but it isn't at all. This product feels so good on my face, I just want to keep reapplying over and over again. No matter how much I put on, it doesn't feel like too much, it just feels good. And since I've been using it, my skin is noticeably more moisturized and smoother. I have been using it every day since received and will continue to use this as apart of my daily skincare routine.

avis.titre: Incorrect ingredient listing, but a nice fragrance-free serum.
avis.texte: • Would I get it again or recommend it and why: -For myself, maybe I do like the formula, but the price per ounce is mid-ranged vs value priced. -For others, if you are comfortable with the price, it's a nice mid-weight fragrance free serum with a good formula. -Note that the ingredients in the listing are not correct. They are not what is on the label. (I'll list the ingredients below.) • Size: -1.01 oz (30 ml) • Quality and Value: -The value for the size and formula is more of a mid ranged price than a value price per ounce. -The formula is well done and it is a nice formula. • Container: -Slightly frosted see through glass dropper top bottle. • Formula: -Amber-straw colored serum that's moderately thick. -It’s not quite a liquid and not a gel, but a thicker serum. • Scent: -No added fragrances, perfumes, essential oils or fragrant plant oils or extracts. -I could detect no scent at at all. -It's safe for those sensitive to scents. • Application and Use: -It's a mid weight, moderately thick serum. -It spread over the skin well and felt lightly hydrating. -Most people would need to use an additional product for moisture over this, unless your skin is oily to very oily. -It works well as the liquid or serum layer in skincare layering. -It's likely best used at night or bedtime vs under makeup, as the texture is a bit sticky and tacky. • Sensitive skin: -I would consider it sensitive skin friendly. -I had no issues on my sensitive skin. -No burning, itching, redness, stinging,

I am happy to find a good water-based and lightweight ampoule that I can use year-round. I liked that it is not sticky on the skin and is absorbed quickly. All 12 ingredients are safe and it does not contain any artificial perfume. Most ingredients are focused on moisturization. I have very sensitive skin that is easily irritated even by all-natural skincare items. This one does not cause any trouble and immediately hydrates my skin without suffocating feelings. It might be a little pricey for the amount but it is worth it.

avis.titre: A leaf after my own heart!
avis.texte: I really like this serum. I did not notice any scent, which I appreciate. It was well-packaged and the product is in a nice, heavy glass bottle with a glass stopper. The serum has a nice texture and goes on smoothly for application. It also absorbs fairly quickly. I noticed one commenter say they felt it was tacky and needed to apply at night before bed, but I cannot say I experienced that. My skin is soft, glowy, and smooth after using it just a few times.

You really cannot go wrong when it comes to korean skin care, but this product is amazing. I have VERY sensitive skin, so I always make sure to look at the ingredients and these are great. I have used this for several nights now after toning and cleansing and wake up in the morning moisturized with no irritation. I love it so far.

So far I am very much enjoying using this serum! It feels absolutely lovely on my skin and I look forward to the positive benefits I will get from using it for a longer period of time. Recommend this for anyone looking for this type of a product.
This Anua heartleaf serum is now my absolute favorite serums its highly moisturizing and leaves my skin glowing . I use it every morning before my daily face cream . I would highly recommend .
